tools.name: identify_mark
tools.description: Ranks catalogue marks that match a description of a mark: visible wording or letters, symbols, outline shape, colour, how it was made, category, country and years of use. Returns pages of marks with maker, image, period and the details that matched, plus a link to the same search on Marks & Signatur

tools.name: find_makers
tools.description: Searches makers and their aliases by name across pottery, silver, jewelry, glass and other maker marks, optionally within one category or country. Returns pages of makers with place, active years, number of marks and an example mark image.

tools.name: get_details
tools.description: Returns the full public record for one mark or one maker: wording, type, period and dating notes for a mark; history, aliases, what to look for and look-alike makers for a maker. Includes links to the matching pages on Marks & Signatures.

tools.name: get_maker_marks
tools.description: Returns the marks of one maker with images, wording, type and period, in date order. Accepts a maker id or a mark id; with a mark id that mark comes first.

tools.name: list_categories
tools.description: Lists the five mark categories with the number of marks and makers in each and a link to each category page.
